title: AI assistants for founders and small businesses
why: AI can act as a tireless brainstorming partner — drafting plans, pitches, marketing copy and customer replies.
what_is_different: Founders must ground AI suggestions in real customer conversations and real numbers. Market figures from AI must be checked against real sources.

extra_modules.title: From idea to one-page plan
extra_modules.outcome: You can: draft a lean plan and test assumptions
extra_modules.practice: Draft a one-page plan and five interview questions

starter_project: Use AI to draft a one-page business plan, a pitch outline and a customer-interview script — then validate three assumptions with real customers.
pitfalls: Generic plans with no local context

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
